final: WITH status_groups AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS group_avg, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref COLLATE BINARY = s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg FROM status_groups) SELECT AVG(g.group_avg), AVG(g.record_count), AVG(g.group_avg - o.overall_avg) FROM status_groups AS g JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE g.group_avg > o.overall_avg
